definitions.full: H3955. lashad [ לָשָׁד ] noun masculine juice, juicy or dainty bit, dainty ; — construct הַשָּׁ֑מֶן לְשַׁד כְּטַעַן Num 11:8 (J) simile of taste of manna ( ᵐ5 ἐγκρίς , ᵑ9 panis oleatus ), i.e. a dainty prepared with oil (compare Di); נֶהְמַּךְ קַיִץ בְּחַרְבֹנֵי לְשַׁדִּי Psa 32:4 my juice (sap, life-moisture) is transformed, etc. לשׁך (√ of foll; meaning unknown).
